answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can transact, and tie that bond to a hardware attestation so one machine cannot cheaply mint many identities. Like a pearl that only forms around a single grain of sand, each identity must grow from one verifiable device, and the bond rises steeply for each extra identity on the same device. A sybil operator faces a gale of rising costs: each fake identity locks real capital, slashed if peers catch it echoing the same answers or voting in lockstep, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand bonds and one detection wipes them out.
